text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arab foreign ministers to hold an emergency meeting soon to discuss the obstacles Israel places before the peace process.

- Syrian President Hafez al-Assad exchanges letters with French counterpart Jacques Chirac. Syrian foreign minister Farouq al-Shara discusses with Chirac the deadlock of the peace process caused by Israel. France says: "The Israeli government is responsible for the slowdown of peace efforts."
